name: BW373U86
summary: (+)-BW373U86 is an opioid analgesic drug used in scientific research.

pharmacology.text: BW373U86 is a selective agonist for the δ-opioid receptor, with approximately 15× stronger affinity for the δ-opioid than the μ-opioid receptor. The mechanism for this is complex and may be separate from its delta agonist effects.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to study the delta opioid receptor. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究 δ 鴉片受體的實驗室工具，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究 δ 鸦片受体的实验室工具，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. In animals it causes convulsions, which is one reason delta opioid agonists have been difficult to develop as medicines.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。在動物身上它會引起抽搐，這也是 δ 鴉片促效劑難以發展成藥物的原因之一。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。在动物身上它会引起抽搐，这也是 δ 鸦片促效剂难以发展成药物的原因之一。

fact.en: It was one of the first non-peptide drugs found to switch on the delta opioid receptor, which opened up research on that receptor. In animals, delta agonists like it can cause convulsions.
fact.zh: 它是最早被發現能活化 δ 鴉片受體的非胜肽藥物之一，這開啟了對該受體的研究。在動物身上，像它這樣的 δ 促效劑可能引起抽搐。
fact.zhHans: 它是最早被发现能活化 δ 鸦片受体的非胜肽药物之一，这打开了对该受体的研究。在动物身上，像它这样的 δ 促效剂可能引起抽搐。
